messages:
tony-customer: Hey — after rotating our service secret yesterday, all text generation requests are 403. Embeddings still succeed. Not seeing anything in app logs. Anyone seen generate perms get stripped during rotation?

sophia-cs: Sorry you're hitting this, Tony. Can you paste the failing curl and a decoded JWT payload (just the claims)? small snippets are fine.

ton y-customer: here's a minimal repro (redacted token):

curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOi...REDACTED..." https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate

Response: 403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","required":["inference:generate"]}

I base64-decoded the JWT payload and the scopes claim looks like this: 

{
  "sub": "svc-account:acme-prod",
  "scopes": "embeddings:vector rerank:score",
  "iat": 1728887700,
  "exp": 1728974100
}

So the generate scope is actually missing in the token payload after rotation. Embeddings and rerank are present.

sophia-cs: weird. That suggests something in the provisioning path dropped the generate scope during token minting or a proxy shimmied the claim.

liam-eng: tagging infra — @nina-se and @kube-proxy-bot for ingress/proxy checks. Quick hypothesis: our internal provisioner writes scopes as a space-separated string into an intermediate header and an older Kong/Traefik header parser truncates on the first space or splits values incorrectly. I've seen similar when a header was incorrectly treated as comma-separated.

nina-se: Looking now — provisioner emitted a header X-Internal-Scopes: "inference:generate embeddings:vector rerank:score" to the proxy. Kong had a plugin configured to normalize headers which splits values on whitespace for legacy reasons. The token payload that reached our auth service lost the first value (inference:generate).

kube-proxy-bot: Confirmed: ingress-kong-1 logs show header normalization rule 'split_on_space=true' applied to X-Internal-Scopes between 1728887600-1728887800. Matched flow: provisioner -> kong -> auth-service.

liam-eng: Repro steps I used locally:

1) Run a provisioner job that requests scopes: 
   ./provisioner create-key --scopes "inference:generate embeddings:vector rerank:score" --tenant acme
2) Observe header emitted: 
   X-Internal-Scopes: inference:generate embeddings:vector rerank:score
3) Curl auth-service to decode incoming claims (simulating kong):
   curl -H "X-Internal-Scopes: inference:generate embeddings:vector rerank:score" http://localhost:8080/_debug/claims
   -> service saw: "embeddings:vector rerank:score" only

Workaround: create a console API key (Console -> Org -> API Keys -> Create) which uses the direct minting path (bypasses provisioner header). That restored inference:generate for Tony.

sophia-cs: Tony, can you try the Console-created key and confirm generation works? If yes we'll keep that as a short-term fix while infra patches Kong.

tony-customer: tried the console key — generation now works. Thanks.

liam-eng: Root cause: header normalization/splitting in Kong. Fix: we need to flip the plugin config to preserve raw header values (set split_on_space=false) and add a validation guard in provisioner to URL-encode/quote the scope string to avoid reliance on header parsing. I'll open an infra PR and an internal ticket to add a guard in provisioner.

liam-eng: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/kong-configs/pulls/482 (changes split_on_space=false)

nina-se: Also creating a short-lived migration to re-issue keys that went out between 1728887000-1728887800 for customers who rotated during the window.

sophia-cs: I'll update Tony and open an internal incident so support has a checklist: reproduce, console-key workaround, timeline window, and contact list.

tony-customer: appreciated. A note for other tenants — the rotation UI didn't warn that certain proxies may drop scopes. Maybe worth adding a banner.

sophia-cs: Agreed. We'll add UX banner and a post-rotation validation step to confirm generate & embedding scopes are present. :+1:

liam-eng: Follow-ups: (1) infra PR (link above), (2) provisioner validation ticket #INC-7891, (3) support KB entry; I'll ping when PR is deployed.

kube-proxy-bot: Deployment scheduled: kong-configs PR will be rolled out to staging at 1728891200 and production at 1728894800 (ETA ~2h).

sophia-cs: Closing here once Tony confirms no other tenants impacted. Thanks team. :tada:
